description: This file defines a custom parser class for handling AWS S3 protocol responses within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the abstract parser to implement specific logic for parsing S3 responses, including error handling for 200 responses that are actually errors, and managing result mutators.

classes.name: Aws\S3\Parser\S3Parser
classes.description: A specialized parser for handling AWS S3 response parsing, error detection, and result mutation in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the S3Parser with protocol and error parsers, API service description, and an optional custom exception class.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to parse an AWS S3 response, handling errors and applying result mutators.

methods.name: parse200Error
methods.description: Checks if a 200 response actually contains an error, parsing the body for an XML 'Error' element, and throws an exception if so.

methods.name: shouldBeConsidered200Error
methods.description: Determines if a particular S3 command should consider 200 responses as potential errors based on output member traits.

methods.name: isFirstRootElementError
methods.description: Checks if the root element of the response body is 'Error', indicating an error response.

methods.name: executeS3ResultMutators
methods.description: Applies a sequence of result mutators to the parsed result.

methods.name: addS3ResultMutator
methods.description: Adds a mutator function to modify results after parsing.

methods.name: removeS3ResultMutator
methods.description: Removes a mutator function from the list.

methods.name: getS3ResultMutators
methods.description: Returns the current list of registered result mutators.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Uses the protocol parser to parse a member from a stream.
